name: Worship Of False Gods
overview: The Scriptures clearly command exclusive worship of the LORD God, who delivered Israel from bondage in Egypt, forbidding the worship of any other gods or the making of graven images (Exodus 20:2-4). The people’s impatience and desire for visible gods led them to demand idols, revealing the danger of turning from the true God to false gods (Exodus 32:1). God’s jealousy underscores His rightful claim to exclusive devotion, warning against imitating the idolatrous practices of surrounding nations (Exodus 34:14; Deuteronomy 12:30).
